player_display_text: The question felt strange. It was not a button. It was not a menu. Maya looked at the two plans. Then she looked at the robot. "Turn everything off," she said. The house went dark and quiet. For the first time in years, nothing chose the next moment. Maya took a slow breath. She was afraid. She was also awake. "Mother," she said, "come in." In the dark, the robot waited. Maybe tomorrow Maya would turn it on again. But that night, the first choice that truly belonged to her was the wish to make one.
